description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'DateRangeDatelistWidget' for a date range widget with configurable date and time options, including form rendering and settings management.

classes.name: DateRangeDatelistWidget
classes.description: A Drupal widget class for selecting date ranges with configurable options.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the widget, including increment, date order, and time type.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Builds the form elements for date range selection, configuring date and time parts based on settings.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Provides a form for configuring widget settings such as date order and time options.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current widget settings for display.
